name: plugin.mantis_security_review
description: Google Mantis autonomous security review pipeline, VCS history mining, deduplication ladder, and risk calibration

entrypoints.name: mantis_history_scan
entrypoints.description: Mine VCS repository history for historical vulnerabilities, security fix patterns, and commit trajectories

parameters.name: repo_path
parameters.description: Path to the target Git repository

parameters.name: max_commits
parameters.description: Maximum number of commits to inspect

parameters.name: pattern_filter
parameters.description: Optional keyword or regex filter for commit messages

entrypoints.name: mantis_directory_summary
entrypoints.description: Generate hierarchical security-focused directory map and asset overview

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: Directory path to analyze

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to recursively analyze subdirectories

entrypoints.name: mantis_plan_review
entrypoints.description: Formulate targeted defensive security review plan from threat model and codebase boundaries

parameters.name: threat_model
parameters.description: Active threat model dictionary containing boundaries and components

parameters.name: target_paths
parameters.description: List of prioritized target file or directory paths

parameters.name: focus_cwe
parameters.description: Optional list of priority CWE identifiers to focus on

entrypoints.name: mantis_research_audit
entrypoints.description: Deep-dive static analysis audit of target source code for vulnerability patterns

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Relative or absolute path of the target file

parameters.name: code_content
parameters.description: Raw source code content to audit

parameters.name: focus_cwe
parameters.description: Optional priority CWE list to evaluate

entrypoints.name: mantis_dedupe_ladder
entrypoints.description: Consolidate raw security findings through multi-pass syntactic, AST, and semantic deduplication

parameters.name: findings
parameters.description: List of raw finding dictionaries to deduplicate

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Deduplication mode: 'syntactic_and_ast', 'signature_only', or 'off'

entrypoints.name: mantis_review_gate
entrypoints.description: Independent validation gate evaluating findings against source semantics to eliminate false positives

parameters.name: finding
parameters.description: Finding dictionary to evaluate

parameters.name: source_content
parameters.description: Actual source code where the vulnerability is alleged

parameters.name: strictness
parameters.description: Review strictness: 'high', 'medium', or 'low'

entrypoints.name: mantis_critic_filter
entrypoints.description: Assess production viability of findings, filtering out debug-only features and assertion traps

parameters.name: finding
parameters.description: Finding dictionary to evaluate

parameters.name: check_release_assertions
parameters.description: Whether to verify behavior when assertions are disabled in production builds

entrypoints.name: mantis_chain_exploits
entrypoints.description: Analyze individual security findings to construct multi-stage compound exploit chains

parameters.name: findings
parameters.description: List of confirmed findings to evaluate for chaining

parameters.name: target_objective
parameters.description: High-impact adversary objective (e.g. Remote Code Execution, Auth Bypass)

entrypoints.name: mantis_calibrate_risk
entrypoints.description: Calculate multi-axis risk ratings based on threat intel, impact, criticality, and exploitability

parameters.name: findings
parameters.description: List of findings to calibrate

parameters.name: asset_criticality
parameters.description: Criticality level of target asset: 'critical', 'high', 'medium', or 'low'

entrypoints.name: mantis_generate_report
entrypoints.description: Compile stakeholder-facing security review packet from confirmed findings and exploit chains

parameters.name: findings
parameters.description: List of confirmed, calibrated findings

parameters.name: exploit_chains
parameters.description: Optional list of constructed exploit chains

parameters.name: executive_summary
parameters.description: High-level executive narrative summary
